items.why: Same company (FI 27660236). Each spelling comes from only one procedure. ojs:2023-192170 (tender 7679089, published 2023-10-20) prints 'Fin Vaatturit Oy' on 6 winner lots (LOT-1/2/5/7/10/15), and those lots are all 6 of the 'top' votes. ojs:2019-169831 (tender 6475720, published 2019-11-07) prints 'Finn Vaatturit Oy' on LOT-1. The org has no other buyer or bidder notices. The newest print is 'Fin', so this is not a revert. The two names differ by one letter, and nothing I could find (notices or a web search) shows which spelling is registered. The 6-to-1 majority is lot inflation from one notice, so the change is a coin-flip, not an improvement.

The head 'Communauté des communes ...' is a misspelling of the French legal form; it was printed once, last on 2014-10-09. The org's newest notices all print 'de communes': tender 436812 (2024-07-31) 'Communauté de Communes du Pays d'Issoudun' as Procedure-Buyer and ReviewOrg; tender 624006 (2024-07-24) the same; tender 312248 (2024-06-19) the same; ojs:2018-153373 (6173758, 2018-07-06) 'Communauté de communes du pays d'Issoudun'; ojs:2016-327987 (5753371, 2016-12-31) 'Communauté de communes du Pays d'Issoudun'. The new name fixes the misspelling, and its casing only differs from the 2024 prints.

The head 'OŠ Frana Metelka Škocjan' is the abbreviated form; it was printed twice, last on 2017-04-28. The school's own notices print the full name: tender 554930 (2024-12-13) 'OSNOVNA ŠOLA FRANA METELKA ŠKOCJAN'; ojs:2022-552271 (7517529, 2023-01-18) and ojs:2018-206340 (6200883, 2022-01-26) the same in capitals; ojs:2015-326626 (5517708, 2018-10-27) and ojs:2015-088282 (5398785, 2018-08-03) 'Osnovna šola Frana Metelka Škocjan'. The new name spells out the abbreviation in the casing printed most often. It is the same school (SI 5086388000).

The head 'Základná škola Morovnianska cesta' was printed only in ojs:2022-674207 (7570127, 2023-01-13). The school's two newer notices both print 'Základná škola, Morovnianska cesta 1866/55, Handlová': tender 184976 (2023-11-07) as Procedure-Buyer, and tender 942300 (2024-02-13) as Procedure-Buyer and Contract-Signatory. Slovak school names include the street address and town by convention. The registeruz.sk financial statements for IČO 31201784 (founder: Town of Handlová) carry this full form. So the address text here belongs to the legal name and is not junk. The head is a truncation without number or town, and the new name identifies the school better.

The head 'HaM autoopravy-predaj, s.r.o.' is an old rendering with '&' mangled to 'a'; it was last printed on 2013-11-13. Every recent notice prints 'H & M autoopravy - predaj s.r.o.': tender 1009460 (2024-09-04), tender 666459 (2024-08-09), tenders 802978 and 289822 (both 2023-12-08) as Tenderer, and ojs:2023-082027 (7627079, 2023-09-22) as winner. A CRZ contract names IČO 31559786 as 'H&M autoopravy-predaj s.r.o.', Banská Bystrica. The new name fixes an outdated, mangled head for the same company.

Same company (KRS 0000148010); only the legal form is written differently. ojs:2020-640078 (6977521, 2021-08-13) prints 'Biotronik Polska Spółka z o. o.' on LOT-2/4/6/8, and those lots are all 4 of the 'top' votes. ojs:2019-239270 (6509843, 2020-02-20) prints 'Biotronik Polska sp. z o.o.' on LOT-11/13. These are the org's only notices, one procedure each. The newest print is the new spelling, so this is not a revert. 'sp. z o.o.' is the standard abbreviation and 'Spółka z o. o.' is a half-expanded variant, so neither name is better; the majority is lot inflation.

Same Slovenian school (5084032000) either way. The new name is the full legal name with the public-institution prefix ('Javni vzgojno-izobraževalni zavod' = JVIZ) in front of the head. It is no former name and no different entity. Newest buyer notice: 6748596, published 2020-11-25 (versions 2020-03-13 to 2020-11-25), prints 'Javni vzgojno-izobraževalni zavod Osnovna šola Benedikt'. The head 'Osnovna šola Benedikt' was last printed on 5601329 (2016-06-02, versions 2016-02-03 and 2016-06-02). These are the only two buyer procedures, with no winner or bidder rows. The long official form and the short form name this entity equally well, so the change neither fixes nor breaks anything.

The head is outdated: DONG Energy rebranded as Ørsted in 2017. Every notice since then prints 'Orsted AB'. As buyer: 884590 (2025-01-20), 495135 (2024-10-28), 784692 (2024-10-21) and 777707 (2024-06-03, 'Soft Services ... for Ørsted'). As winner: 7347328 (2022-07-06), 6939898 (2020-12-18) and 6507422 (2019-10-30). The head was last printed as 'DONG Energy AB' on winner notice 5876975 (2017-05-13, Biogas Helsingborg). Same identifier 5566269345. No rival cluster, so top_stale does not apply.

The head is the pre-2013 name. In Hungary's 2013 museum reorganisation, the Bács-Kiskun county museum organisation passed to Kecskemét and continued as 'Kecskeméti Katona József Múzeum'. It is the same contracting authority, under the same AK09892 number. The only buyer procedure is 5604150 (versions 2016-02-06 and 2016-05-11, published 2016-05-11), and it prints 'Kecskeméti Katona József Múzeum'. The head was last printed 2013-06-07 (head_newest). The head's 2 procedures are not reachable through the buyer, winner or bidder filters, so I could not open them. The new name has 17 of 20 votes. It is the org's later and current name, not a sub-unit served for the entity.

Spanish sole trader: 18418330E is a personal NIF. The head is the person's own name. The new name is his trade name, 'Limpiezas' + his name, and both are the same entity. Winner notices that print 'LIMPIEZAS EZEQUIEL POMAR DOMINGUEZ': 7739312 (2023-09-11), 7351462 (2022-10-07, lots 1-8) and 6973282 (2021-11-16, lots 3 and 6). Notice 6916942 (2021-07-14) prints 'Limpiezas Ezequiel Pomar Domínguez'. Notice 6975570 (2022-01-31, lot 73) prints the head form 'EZEQUIEL POMAR DOMINGUEZ'. The two forms alternate, so there was no rename. The new name keeps the accent and is not an agent tail or a different entity. It is equally good, not better.

The head is outdated. Thales Air Systems SAS (RCS 319 159 877) now trades as Thales LAS France SAS. Winner notices 7620095 (2023-02-01) and 7609290 (2023-01-20), TopSky framework II, print 'Thales LAS FRANCE SAS'. Notices 6923493 and 6923492 (both 2020-10-30) print 'Thales las France SAS'. The head 'Thales Air Systems S.A.S.' was last printed on 8003684 (2013-11-22, EUROCAT upgrade). No rival cluster, so top_stale does not apply.

Same company with the same name. The new name only writes out the legal form ('Kft.' becomes 'Korlátolt Felelősségű Társaság') and uses the registered capitals 'JÁSZKERÜLET'. The only buyer procedure, 6025605 (versions 2017-10-04 and 2018-01-12, published 2018-01-12), prints 'JÁSZKERÜLET Kulturális és Művészeti Közhasznú Nonprofit Korlátolt Felelősségű Társaság'. The head 'Jászkerület ... Nonprofit Kft.' was last printed 2013-06-18 (head_newest). The head's 2013 procedure is not reachable through the buyer, winner or bidder filters. Identifier AK17483. There is no rename or revert, and the short and long legal-form spellings are equally good.

FR SIREN/SIRET 20003591300017. The head is the syndicate's former name. The new name is the current one, printed on every notice since 2019. Buyer notices that print the head: 6023069 (2017-09-29) and 6248207 (2018-07-10), 'Syndicat d'electrification Vauclusien'; 6248207 is the last one. Every newer buyer notice prints the new name: 6621832 (2019-10-10), 6626626 (2020-01-24) and 6852401 (2021-01-15) 'Syndicat d'énergie Vauclusien'; 7516764 (2022-10-07), 7875011 (2023-10-20) and 7902462 (2023-12-06) 'syndicat D'Energie VAUCLUSIEN'; 301067 (eForms, 2024-05-24) 'Syndicat d'énergie vauclusien'. No winner rows. The bidder listing returns the same buyer procedures. The rename has been stable for 5 years, so this fixes an outdated head and is not a revert.

IE VAT 8Z80458U. The org appears only as a winner, in 4 printing-services notices. 5256584 (2015-07-04, Cork IT) prints 'Clondalkin Group', which is the head's only print. 5885418 (2017-11-21, Maynooth University), 6529149 (2019-11-06, Oireachtas) and 7102538 (2022-01-25, Houses of the Oireachtas Service) all print 'Essentra Packaging Ireland Ltd'. Essentra took over Clondalkin's packaging and print business in 2015, and every later notice uses the successor's specific legal-entity name. The head is an outdated parent-group name, so the change is right and not a revert.

RO CUI 16962508 / RO16962508. Winner only. The two spellings alternate across the same supplier's vehicle contracts: 7107621 (2021-09-17) 'S.C. NESTE AUTOMOTIVE S.R.L.', 7367475 (2022-08-23) 'NESTE AUTOMOTIVE', 7497653 (2022-11-04) 'NESTE AUTOMOTIVE', 7632501 (2023-06-27) 'S.C. NESTE AUTOMOTIVE S.R.L.', 7713318 (2023-10-04, newest, lots 1 and 2) 'NESTE AUTOMOTIVE'. It is the same entity either way. The new name drops the 'S.C. ... S.R.L.' legal-form wrapper, which is neither better nor worse. It is not a former or superseded name.

CZ IČO 64991300. Buyer only, in the joint electricity tenders of Uničov/Šternberk. 6243789 (2018-11-13) prints 'Sbor dobrovolných hasičů Horní Sukolom', the head's last print. 7448343 (2022-10-21), 7670568 (2023-03-24) and 8525791 (2023-10-11) all print 'SH ČMS - Sbor dobrovolných hasičů Horní Sukolom'. That is the form fire-brigade branches use as spolek-register names, so the newest notices consistently print it. The 'SH ČMS -' prefix names the parent association that this branch belongs to. It is not an agent tail and not a member-for-association swap. Same entity, under its current registered name.

PL NIP 7471528431, a sole trader (Krystian Thoma, trading as Thomex). 6826779 (2021-01-19, winner) prints 'Thomex Krystian Thoma', the head's only print. 7451771 (2022-11-25, winner), 556386 (2024-07-19, tenderer) and 1086281 (2025-02-28, tenderer) print 'KRYSTIAN THOMA THOMEX'. 684701 (2024-02-05, tenderer) prints 'Krystian Thoma Thomex'. The same words are in a different order. The new order matches what every notice since 2022 prints, but it identifies the entity no better or worse.

LT company code 300021499. Winner only. 5904058 (2017-10-03) prints 'Uždaroji akcinė bendrovė „Verslo ir neįgaliųjų vystymo grupė“' (legal form spelled out), the head's last print. 6225378 (2018-11-07) prints 'UAB „Verslo ir neįgaliųjų vystymo grupė“'. 6656386 (2020-02-28), 6556260 (2020-05-08) and 6600012 (2023-01-23) print 'UAB Verslo ir neįgaliųjų vystymo grupė' (6600012 lot 3 has quotes). 7590689 (2023-05-17) prints 'UAB "Verslo ir neįgaliųjų vystymo grupė"'. 6865015 (2024-02-02) prints 'UAB Verslo ir neįgaliųjų vystymo grupė' / 'UAB Verslo ir Neįgaliųjų Vystymo Grupė'. Same company. The new name only writes the legal form as the standard abbreviation UAB instead of spelling it out, so the two are equally good.

FR SIRET 35780203200031 (merged sibling 35780203200049, same SIREN 357802032). The head 'La Moselle-Maison Familiale' appears only on the 2016 notices: tender 5576032 (337030-2016, 2016-09-29) and 5574438 (337031-2016, 2016-09-29). Every later notice for this identifier prints the Batigere name: 7078303 (233511-2021, 2021-05-10) 'Batigère Maison Familiale'; 7444499 (385081-2022, 2022-07-15), 7611248 (043497-2023, 2023-01-23) and 778933 (00463412-2024, 2024-08-01) all print 'BATIGERE MAISON FAMILIALE'. On 778933 it is a co-buyer with its sister companies BATIGERE HABITAT and BATIGERE RHONES ALPES. This is a rename of the same legal entity, so the head is the outdated former name. new_name is the current name in proper case with the accent. No rival cluster, so top_stale does not apply.

HU AK16866. Pannon Egyetem is a separate org, 1857821, with its own identifier AK06088. In the joint university energy procurements both appear as separate buyers: 5663639 (356516-2016, 2016-10-13) has 1857821 'Pannon Egyetem' plus this org printed 'Nereus Park Hotel Kft.', and 6009908 (013441-2018, 2018-01-12) has 1857821 'Pannon Egyetem' plus this org printed 'Nereus Park Hotel Kft'. The head's only source is 4842715 (000218-2013, 2013-01-02). There this org holds two purchasing-body mentions, 'Pannon Egyetem' and 'Nereus Park Hotel Kft.', while org 1857821 got 'Óbudai Egyetem'. That is a shifted party list, not a former name. So the head serves another entity (the parent university) for its hotel company. new_name is the entity's own name, printed on every notice that carries AK16866.

SE 6806076995 is a personnummer-style number, so this is a sole trader. The head 'Träd, sten & ängar' (its trading name) was printed once, on 6224517 (466001-2018, 2018-10-23, winner). The only later procedure is 553252 (Norrköpings kommun, 2024-01-24 to 2024-08-26, final 00510561-2024, 2024-08-26). Its Tenderer LOT-0001 mention, on each of four notice versions, prints the owner's register name 'HAHRE, STEFAN', and this org is a LOT-0001 winner there. Both names designate the same sole proprietorship. The trading name is not shown to be dropped; the 2024 buyer simply printed the owner's legal name. The inverted all-caps format is register style, and neither name is clearly better. Same entity, about equally good.

NO 974685019 (also MVA NO974685019MVA). The head 'Victoria' (no legal form) appears only on 5744926 (384311-2017, 2017-09-29, winner LOT-1). Every later notice adds the 'AS': 7113264 (261054-2022, 2022-05-16) 'Victoria AS'; 7167223 (530849-2022, 2022-09-28) 'VICTORIA AS'; 7752202 (559455-2023, 2023-09-18) 'VICTORIA AS' on LOT-4 and LOT-5; 990737 (00609518-2024, 2024-10-09), 108756 (00127242-2025, 2025-02-26) and 530544 (00658511-2025, 2025-10-08) all print 'Victoria AS'. new_name is the full company name of the same entity and is current through 2025-10. The bare 'Victoria' head was a truncation.

AT FN 162725b. The head 'Maschinenring Salzburg reg. Gen. m.b.H.' is printed on 6487058 (451081-2019, 2019-09-25, winner LOT-18). The newer notices print the legal form spelled out, 'Maschinenring Salzburg registrierte Genossenschaft mit beschränkter Haftung': 6628560 (272249-2020, 2020-06-11, winner on LOTs 1/3/5/7/9/11) and 295450 (00629855-2024, 2024-10-17, Tenderer LOT-0016). Same entity and same name; only the legal-form suffix is abbreviated or written out. Both serve equally well. Not a rename and not a revert.

SI 5877881000. The head is the short name 'Avtohiša Kolmanič & Dokl d.o.o.', printed on 5569432 (254950-2016, 2016-07-23, winner LOT-5). The newer notices print the full registered name: 7450294 (696847-2022, 2022-12-16, winner LOT-2) and 846858 (00337621-2025, 2025-05-26, Tenderer LOT-0002) both read 'AVTOHIŠA KOLMANIČ & DOKL, trgovina in servis d.o.o.'. This is the same company: full registered name with its activity clause ('trgovina in servis') versus the registered short name. new_name is current but is no clearer than the head. Equally good, no revert.

The head is a procedure title, not an organization. It was printed once, in the 2018-01-30 contract notice (041234-2018, v1 of procedure 6114750). Every later notice prints the buyer as 'Město Olešnice': 6114750 v3 (213234-2018, 2018-05-18) and 6154361 'ZŠ Olešnice - Moderně a komplexně - dodávky - II' (268069-2018, 2018-06-22). The org has no winner or bidder rows. Identifier 00280755 is a CZ national IČO and fits the town as the contracting authority; 'ZŠ Olešnice' is the town's school project. The new name fixes junk text and is not a former name.

The head 'Tmi Jukka Similä / Hailuodon Taksi' was printed only on 8393377 (2017-05-31, winner). All later notices print 'Tmi Jukka Similä': 7113814 (2022-02-23, winner), 7706315 (2023-10-17, winner x9) and 49776 (2024-12-20, Tenderer). Identifier FI23287075 (merged 23287075) is the same sole trader. The new name is the current name. It drops a trading-name suffix that has not been printed since 2017, so it is not a revert.

Same entity and same name; only the legal form is written differently. 'Garden Kertészeti és Erdészeti Szolgáltató Kft.' was printed on 6442604 (2019-06-20, winner). The full form 'Garden Kertészeti és Erdészeti Szolgáltató Korlátolt Felelősségű Társaság' was printed on the newer 6791589 (2020-10-09, winner) and 6685914 (2020-12-23, winner x3). Kft. is the standard abbreviation of Korlátolt Felelősségű Társaság, so both serve equally well. The change is not wrong, since the newer notices print the full form.

Same company; AB is the standard abbreviation of Aktiebolag. 'SICK AB' was printed only on 6097295 (2018-01-04, winner). 'SICK Aktiebolag' is printed on 7633772 (2023-04-19, winner), 68726 (2024-01-17, Tenderer) and 100776 (2025-04-07, Tenderer). Identifier SE556463224701 (merged 5564632247) is one company. Both names serve equally well; the new one matches the current notices.

In the head, 'B.' is a list marker. On 5627223 (Uppsala universitet, 2017-07-15) every winner carries it: 'B. Kärnhuset Järnfeldt Karlsson AB', 'B. Hillmarketing AB,' and 'B. Zellout AB'. Every other notice prints 'Zellout AB': 6543337 (2020-01-08), 6680932 (2020-08-07), 7235329 (2022-04-15), 7204096 (2022-10-24) and 7512534 (2023-02-07), all as winner. The new name removes the stray prefix from the same company (identifier 5566138144).

The head 'Kommunale Verwaltung' is a generic type name. It was printed only on 4653180 (2011-11-18, buyer), and that notice's own text reads 'Die Gemeinde Merchweiler beabsichtigt...' with the title 'Gemeinde Merchweiler, Hauptstraße 82'. Later notices print 'Gemeinde Merchweiler' as buyer: 7715986 (2023-05-08), 316330 (2024-08-26), 927818 (2025-03-26) and 829977 (2025-04-10). Identifier 10043113 is Merchweiler's municipality code in Landkreis Neunkirchen (10043). The new name replaces the generic type with the specific entity.

SIRET 51373754400058 (merged 51373754400074) is Europ'TP. The head 'ETPE' was printed exactly once, on LOT-1 of 6601918 (2019-09-12), and that same notice prints 'Europ TP' three times. Every later notice prints a Europ'TP spelling: 6618563 (2019-10-02) "EUROP'TP" on 11 lots, 7052436 (2021-04-12) 'Europ'TP', 7665136 (2023-09-20) "EUROP'TP", 67398 (2026-04-23) "EUROP'TP SAS_03/_04", 7944731 (2026-09-01) 'EUROP TP' and 7950030 (2026-09-04) 'EUROP TP'. 'ETPE' is a one-off acronym. 'Europ TP' is the company's real name and still in use, so this replaces an abbreviation and is not a former name.

NIP 7781002137. The head was printed only up to mid-2021: 6321411 (2019-01-18) 'Sigma-Aldrich Sp. z o.o.', 6835213 (2020-10-26) 'Sigma-Aldrich Spółka z o.o.', 6947370 (2021-03-26) 'Sigma – Aldrich Sp. z o.o.', 6975003 (2021-07-05) 'SIGMA – ALDRICH Sp. z o.o.'. NIP 5213381661. The head 'SoftMed Sp. z o. o. Członkiem Konsorcjum' ('member of the consortium') appears only on 7840988 (2023-10-13), and the consortium-role tail is junk. Every newer notice prints the plain company name: 1021611 (2026-06-17) 'Soft Med Sp. z o.o.', 339268 (2026-06-18) 'SOFTMED sp. z o.o.', 851245 (2026-06-25) 'SoftMed Sp. z o.o.'. SIRET 24570140400056. The head spelling with 'du' was printed only once, by the buyer itself, on 6047168 (2017-10-28) "Communauté de communes du Pays Haut Val d'Alzette". REGON 122729525. The head "Konsorcjum: lider: Małopolskie Przedsiębiorstwo Gospodarki Odpadami Sp. z o.o.)" (consortium-leader text with a stray parenthesis) appears only on 6702164 (2020-01-14). Z O.O.', 557071 (2025-07-01) and 81078 (2026-02-09) 'Małopolskie Przedsiębiorstwo Gospodarki Odpadami Sp. z o.o.', 1067083 (2025-12-17) in upper case. OIB 29524210204. VIPnet d.o.o. was renamed A1 Hrvatska d.o.o. in 2018. The head was printed up to 5948311 (2017-12-19) and 6022842 (2018-03-29) 'VIPnet d.o.o.'. PL NIP 8990102145. The notices print the sp. z o.o. form up to the end of 2022: 7116699 (2021-11-23) 'Zakład Automatyki Przemysłowej INTEC Sp. z o.o.' and 7446710 (2022-12-21) '...INTEC Spółka z ograniczoną odpowiedzialnością'.
